description: This file defines the 'I18NLanguageAPI' class, a REST API endpoint for managing internationalization (i18n) languages within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for listing, retrieving, updating, and deleting language entities, with appropriate validation rules and OpenAPI annotations for documentation. The class interacts with DAOs and models to perform CRUD operations specific to language data.

classes.name: I18NLanguageAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for CRUD operations on I18N (internationalization) language entities within the system.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all language entries, supports filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Not implemented; throws not implemented exception.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Not implemented; throws not implemented exception.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove language entries by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the delete method.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single language entry by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update a language entry; currently updates 'added' flag and modification timestamp.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the update method.
